summary: Preserve public class field definition semantics: creating the own field must not invoke an inherited setter of the same name.

target.notes: Define an own data property directly through the JavaScript-compatible object model rather than lowering the field initializer to ordinary property assignment.

caveats: A generated C# property setter or assignment is not a safe substitute for class-field definition semantics across inheritance.

tests.name: inherited setter not invoked
tests.input: class B { set x(v){ console.log('setter'); } } class D extends B { x=1; } new D();

tests.name: edge: later assignment can use normal Set semantics
tests.input: class B { set x(v){ console.log('setter'); } } class D extends B { x=1; m(){ delete this.x; this.x=2; } } const d=new D(); d.m();
tests.expected_behavior: after deleting the own field, assigning x can reach the inherited setter and prints setter
